points.quote: `src/vs/workbench/workbench.common.main.ts` is the shared entry point. ... `workbench.web.main.ts` and `workbench.desktop.main.ts` each start with `import './workbench.common.main.js'`.
The same service interface therefore gets a different implementation on each platform.
Code gets loaded only if some entry file imports it, directly or transitively.

It is a long list of side-effect imports (`import './contrib/notebook/browser/notebook.contribution.js'` and so on). ... A contribution that isn't imported by `common.main`, `web.main` or `desktop.main` is never bundled or run.
